# codebase-claudeforge

TypeScript Discord/web operator surface. Proves the surface↔runtime seam:
`hermes-provider.ts` already runs Hermes as a backend provider with
`X-Hermes-Session-Id` continuity. Keep as **interface contract**, not as the
canonical surface — surfaces should not own state.

## Why this matters

Proves the surface↔runtime seam is real, not theoretical. The TypeScript Discord/web shell already runs Hermes as a backend provider with `X-Hermes-Session-Id` continuity. Keep this branch as an **interface contract** — surfaces should not own state, but the contract that connects them to Hermes is good prior art.

## What lives here

- `packages/server/src/providers/hermes-provider.ts` — the working seam
- `packages/server/test/session-manager-hermes.test.ts` — session contract tests
- `packages/server/test/hermes-provider.test.ts`
- `packages/bot/test/hermes-commands.test.ts` — Discord-side commands

## Where it connects

- Snapshot also lives inside `codebase-ema` at `code/ema/claudeforge/`
- Pattern donor for: `codebase-frontend-layer`, `codebase-mission-control-claude`
- Doctrine consumer for harness driver design: `docs-clis-mcps-integrations`

## How to load it efficiently

```bash
git show origin/codebase-claudeforge:packages/server/src/providers/hermes-provider.ts
```
